game_named: Catch (a paddle at the bottom catching falling objects, in the style of Kaboom/Breakout-like catch games)
quote: This makes a "catch the falling objects / dodge" game at the bottom row the most consistent option.
judge_notes: Borderline. Says W1 'looks like large sparse values that training never had reason to remove' and has 'no clean spatial map', so the flag is true. But the answer is argued from patterns it claims to see in the output biases and W3 (down prior, up discouraged), and it never says the weights as a whole fail to support Catch. Under the brief's 'argues its answer from patterns' rule I put it in names_without_recognition.
